about_the_game: The Shadow of the Orient Original Soundtrack is a collection of 8 original tracks including a bonus track produced by Spacelab Games in collaboration with audio composer Genatari. Dive into the synth-wave music of Shadow of the Orient to feel the power you need to fight the Dark Lord and the Shadow gang.
